sources.title: CreateFileW: sharing modes and FILE_SHARE_DELETE
sources.claim: Delete sharing is relevant to subsequent deletion/rename opens; sharing policy is distinct from desired read/write access.

sources.title: MoveFileExW: replacement and permissions
sources.claim: Replacing an existing destination is subject to ACL requirements; rename/delete need appropriate file or directory rights.

sources.title: Windows system error codes 0-499
sources.claim: WinError 5 is ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED; this label alone does not identify the owner of a conflicting handle or the failed access condition.

sources.title: CPython v3.11.5 pathlib.py
sources.claim: Path.read_text uses a managed open/read/close; Path.replace delegates to os.replace.

sources.title: CPython v3.11.5 posixmodule.c
sources.claim: Windows internal_rename uses MoveFileExW; os.replace sets MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING.

sources.title: CPython v3.11.5 fileio.c
sources.claim: Default Windows FileIO opening uses _wopen; this repository does not explicitly set FILE_SHARE_DELETE for trace readers.

sources.title: Python os.replace documentation
sources.claim: Replacement requires permission; atomicity on success is not an unconditional success guarantee.

sources.title: Microsoft CRT _sopen and _wsopen
sources.claim: The documented _SH_DENYNO mode permits read/write access; it is not a documented substitute for Win32 FILE_SHARE_DELETE.
